definitions.explanation: A house that is not occupied.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{家|や}が{増|ふ}えている。
あの{空|あ}き{家|や}は{古|ふる}い。
{空|あ}き{家|や}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a vacant house.

notes:
{空|あ}き{家|や} refers to a house with no one living in it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空|あ}き{家|や}が{増|ふ}える (vacant houses increase)
- {空|あ}き{家|や}を{利用|りよう}する (use a vacant house)
- {空|あ}き{家|や}{問題|もんだい} (vacant house problem)

RELATED WORDS:
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}: vacant lot
- {空|あ}き{室|しつ}: vacant room
- {空|あ}き{缶|かん}: empty can

Note: {空|あ}き{家|や} has become a social issue in Japan due to aging population and rural depopulation.
